The spiciness of these sautéed peppers has been broken by the heat for a sweeter taste.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Sautéed Peppers are made by [[Cooking]] [[Spicy Pepper]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Since their only ingredient is Spicy Pepper, there is no default version of them, and only Spicy Sautéed Peppers can be made. Eating these [[Meals]] will grant [[Link]] one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. They will also heal a number of his [[Heart]]s.
